title: eludite.view.show input
description: Show and activate a tool window (View menu, e.g. View > Workspace) or a document tab. A closed tool window reopens where it was; an auto-hidden one slides out; a tabbed one becomes the active tab of its group. `web_browser` (View > Other Windows > Web Browser) opens the Web Browser window as a document tab, as Visual Studio does. `git_changes` is Git Changes (View > Git Changes, Ctrl+0, Ctrl+G) and `git_repository` the Git Repository window (Git > Manage Branches, Ctrl+0, Ctrl+R; brief 0040). `terminal` is the Terminal window (View > Terminal, Ctrl+`; brief 0041): shown from the menu or the key it starts a shell when it has none; shown by an agent it starts nothing (eludite.terminal.open does). `find_results_1` and `find_results_2` are Visual Studio's Find Results 1 and Find Results 2 windows (View > Other Windows > Find Results 1, 2; brief 0042), closed until a search shows one, then tabbed at the bottom.

id.description: Tool window id (e.g. workspace, properties, error_list, output, toolbox, git_changes, git_repository, terminal, find_results_1, find_results_2, web_browser) or document tab id.
